scope: Full statements, proofs, rubrics and mathematical edge cases of all24new algorithm syllabus-gap tasks; metadata reviewed, retirement preserved.
hash_algorithm: SHA256(UTF8(json.dumps({k:problem[k] for k in ["title","statement","criterions","reference_solution"]}, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True))); Python default separators include comma-space and colon-space; no appended newline.

executed_checks.scope: 5000 seeded random arithmetic cases across bases2,3,10,16,256 for add/sub/multiply/divide
executed_checks.limitation: Execution reported by author; mathematical proofs independently read by reviewer.

records.proof_review: Signed addition/subtraction carry and borrow invariants checked, equal-modulus and canonical zero handled.
Row multiplication checked including unused final cell, normalized carry and strict accumulator bound B^2.
Prefix quotient invariant, digit range, remainder uniqueness and m+1-digit workspace checked.
Linearity of expectation needs no joint independence; fixed-key nonadaptive premise and operation model explicit.
Pigeonhole adaptive collision set and exact sum of failed chain comparisons checked; lower bound limited to stated chain implementation.
Rehash movement requires no duplicate searches; deterministic epoch sizes, fresh hash expectation and geometric rebuild sum checked.
BST successor transplant checked both direct-child and deeper cases, identity-preserving links and absence of self-cycle.
AVL recurrence and LL/LR height proofs checked including empty subtree edge cases; symmetric cases follow by reversal.
Multiset count versus node count, transplant of full multiplicity, size recomputation order and rank/select boundaries checked.
Trie terminal/pass invariant checked for empty string, repeated strings and safe freeing only zero subtrees.
Most-significant XOR greedy dominance checked with witnesses and deletion-dependent live memory bound.
Group cancellation order verified; S3 conjugation counterexample evaluated under stated right-to-left convention.
Four corner indicator expansion and two successive prefix transforms checked including boundary sentinel cells.
Bellman-Ford seeds without mutation checked; reachable negative cycle detection, downstream closure and finite optimal paths justified.
Floyd negative diagonal/reachability criterion checked for parallel edges and negative self-loops; no premature minus-infinity arithmetic.
Articulation >= criterion checked, separate DFS root rule and parent-edge ID treatment valid in multigraphs.
Quickselect phase argument uses uniform bounded success conditional on current state; geometric-size work sum and positive-probability worst path correct.
Quicksort pair indicator probability 2/(j-i+1) and exact harmonic sum checked; independent random pivot premise explicit.
Bottom-up heapify bound via number of vertices with depth-h descendants checked; heapsort suffix invariant and repeats correct.
DFS gray-edge certificate reconstruction and reverse finish order checked including loops and disconnected graphs.
All invalid-input checks precede mutation; list reversal preserved tail, prefix and ownership premise checked.
Floyd entry proof and all acyclic/one-cycle/same-entry/different-entry cases checked without mutating links.
Flat immutable string copy counts versus deferred concatenation tree costs and peak-memory distinction correct.
Bit-cost modular exponentiation checked with 2b-bit product and school division; initial reduced base and input exponent storage explicit.
